regimeSub: GDP stuck at 1.5% with CPI at 3.5%; Fed on hold pre-Jackson Hole as markets await Warsh direction.
themes: Q2 GDP confirmed at 1.5% YoY vs prior ~2% with CPI sticky at 3.5% → stagflation math crystallizes; real growth-inflation gap widest since 2022
Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole 'Big Picture' speech looms as the catalyst → 3 hawkish dissents on Jul 29 hold signal bias to hike; no Fed speakers this week leaves market adrift
Brent grinds higher to $90.12 (+$2.14 from $87.98) → Hormuz normalization fading from narrative as supply concerns resurface; cost-push inflation risk re-enters
Gold holds bid at $4111 despite VIX collapse to 15.99 → stagflation hedge demand persists as real rates compress with growth slowdown; DXY soft at 99.72 supports metals

signalNotes.name: US Real Rate
signalNotes.note: 10Y at 4.68% minus 3.5% CPI = 1.18% real; compressed vs Jun on growth fears, still restrictive.

signalNotes.name: 2s10s Curve
signalNotes.note: 2s at 4.23%, 10s at 4.68% → +45bp steepening; bear steepener as long-end prices stagflation risk.

signalNotes.name: HY Credit Spread
signalNotes.note: VIX at 15.99 suggests HY spreads tight; complacency vs stagflation backdrop is a setup for repricing.

signalNotes.name: VIX
signalNotes.note: 15.99 down from 17.09; vol crushed despite macro deterioration → pre-Jackson Hole calm before storm.

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: $90.12 up $2.14 WoW; supply concerns resurface post-Hormuz normalization, cost-push inflation risk rebuilding.

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: $4111 holding near highs; stagflation hedge bid intact as real rates compress on growth slowdown.

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: 1426 vs 1432 prior; KRW firming as BOK hike Aug expectations firm, rate diff narrowing supportive.

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: Risk-on persists with SPX at 7489; SOX likely bid but vulnerable to stagflation repricing in tech multiples.

headline: Stagflation regime solidifies as GDP remains at 1.5% against 3.5% CPI, with Brent grinding back above $90 and markets drifting in pre-Jackson Hole vacuum awaiting Warsh's policy signal.
